title: The barbell row: what it REALLY works 💪
caption:
Lats, mid back, rear shoulders and biceps, while your lower back and hamstrings hold you in place. If you have to jerk it, it's too heavy. Do you row? 👇

Exercise Series, Part 7
sources: Fenwick CMJ, Brown SHM, McGill SM. Comparison of different rowing exercises: trunk muscle activation and lumbar spine motion, load, and stiffness. J Strength Cond Res 2009;23:1408-1417
